summary: Short kerb on a through road, no parked cars, steep, shorter than a van.

drivers.seclusion: Bank and bush to the west, nearest home 52 m away; seclusion would be fine.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road with no pull-off; a dirt strip beyond the end looks like a footpath, not a stopping place.
drivers.traffic: Through route next to a junction with painted islands.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the kerb and no marked parking lane.

sun_shade: Open to sun; shaded by trees on the south-west side.
cannot_judge: Whether the dirt strip is driveable
